limitations: Two fixed synthetic scenes are used for both fitting and measurements. This tests fitting only, with no independent generalization, Atari, transfer or accelerated-learning claim.
Exactly256P-image-L1-only Adam updates per arm, pooled then ordered, seed764; no early stop on loss, no retry, no replacement seed or extension after a miss.
Pooled deterministic mean error has lower bound0.0234375; declared ordered fitting criterion is final mean error strictly below0.01171875. Numerical execution completion is reported separately.
Each input contains only the observed RGB pair or its pool, and an identical UNKNOWN12-effect vector. Only future RGB supervises P; coordinates and direction do not enter the model as labels.
Only synthetic CPU tensors, no native environment, real archive, GPU or reusable trained checkpoint. No measured architecture speed comparison; ARC3 may continue independently.
Work ceiling300seconds before updates and at end, excluding source-proof hashing; retain errors and any uncertain optimizer step, and never retry that attempt.
Fitting uses only the prediction image term; this is not the future P/C/G/I training recipe. Pixel-loss/local-gradient counterexamples and prior negative C observations remain unchanged.
